item.title: Next-gen total-body PET scanner yields diagnostic images in 1 minute
item.description: Research shows a next-generation total-body PET/CT scanner can produce diagnostic-quality images in as little as 1 minute of scanning.

item.title: Pennsylvania's aging prisons not built for extreme weather, risking women and seniors
item.description: When outdoor temperatures spike to 103 F (39 C) or drop to -9 F (-23 C), as they did across Pennsylvania last year, aging prisons leave women and seniors at risk.

item.title: Preoperative self-preparation for knee arthroplasty is multifactorial and optimizable
item.description: Pre-operative self-preparation for older adults undergoing total knee arthroplasty (TKA) is multifactorial and can be optimized by addressing patient factors.

item.title: Lawsuit challenges development of dietary guidelines
item.description: A physicians' group has sued to withdraw the 2025-2030 Dietary Guidelines for Americans, alleging a secretive, conflicted process.
